ACCESS: https://loaf.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST via probe.fetch (HTTP 200, profile edge101). It has exactly THREE groups - 'User-Agent: *', 'User-Agent: Googlebot' (Disallow: empty) and 'User-Agent: Googlebot-image' (Disallow: empty) - and names NO anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web or Claude agent, and carries no Crawl-delay and no Content-Signal line. The '*' group disallows twelve patterns: *?base*, *?colour*, *?list*, *?mattress*, *?page*, *?product*, *?ref*, *?size*, *?valance*, *?variant*, /images/ and /javascript. I HONOURED THESE STRICTLY - in particular I did NOT paginate with ?page=, which the '*' group forbids and which the prior Furniture pass on this SR had used; every count below therefore comes from the first, canonical, query-string-free page only. No facet URL, no ?type= URL and no ?sort= URL was requested. Declared sitemaps: /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-sofa-images.xml, /sitemap-other-images.xml. Transport was plain curl_cffi; every request HTTP 200, no WAF, no proxy.

TREE - TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES, BOTH SHOWING NO BATHROOM:
(1) MEGA-MENU. https://loaf.com/ fetched live (HTTP 200, 91,256 bytes, profile chrome120). Its server-rendered nav.header__navigation yields 120 absolute links and SIX top-level departments: 'Sofas & Chairs' (All sofas, Modular, Corner, Chaise, Sofa beds, In-stock, footstools x7, chairs x5, Additional covers, Cushions, Blankets & quilts); 'Beds & Mattresses' (All beds + 5 children, headboards, mattresses, daybeds, bedding, bed linen, duvets & pillows, blankets, quilts, toppers); 'Tables, Chairs & Storage' (sitting-room furniture x5, kitchen furniture x3, bedroom furniture x6); 'Homewares' (rugs & runners, seat pads, beanbags & floor cushions, duvets & pillows, dog beds, mugs, trays, MIRRORS, storage baskets, slippers, socks, hot water bottles, Shop all homewares); 'Discover More'; and 'OUTLET' (bag-a-bargain). There is NO Bathroom, Bath, Bathroom Accessories, Sanitaryware, Showers, Basins, Taps or Bathroom Storage entry anywhere in the menu.
(2) SITEMAP. https://loaf.com/sitemap.xml fetched in full (HTTP 200, 121,180 bytes, 1,036 <loc> entries - 451 /products/ PDPs and 585 non-product URLs). I read out ALL 585 non-product URLs and grepped every one of the 1,036 for bath|bathroom|shower|basin|sink|toilet|tap|vanit|sanitar|wc|soap|wash|towel|mirror. The complete hit list is TEN URLs: /mirrors plus its seven mirror PDPs (medium/wide/tall-real-deal-arch-mirror, real-deal-mirror, large/medium/tall-florin-mirror), /bath-towels, and /edits/whitewashed-oak (a colour edit - 'wash' substring). That is the entire bath-family footprint of the site. There is no shower, no enclosure, no basin, no toilet, no bathroom tap, no vanity unit, no bathroom cabinet, no bathroom storage and no bathroom accessory node anywhere in the published sitemap.

WHAT THE TWO REAL CANDIDATES TURNED OUT TO BE: /bath-towels is a genuine but currently EMPTY towels listing (totalResults 0) and towels go to Textile under rules 15/20 - routed out, see `review`. /mirrors is a decorative handmade wall-mirror node (arch and round mirrors, H1 'Handmade Mirrors') sitting in the Homewares column with no bathroom framing - excluded under rules 2/11/29, see `review`. Neither is a Bathroom row.

QTY: no Bathroom row exists, so no Bathroom quantity was taken. The three figures quoted in `review` (0, 8, 2) are each the listing page's OWN rendered total, read from the data-data JSON blob that Loaf embeds on every listing page (data-data="{"totalResults":N,"startRow":1,"listingIsFiltered":false}"). VERIFICATION that this is the site's real counter and not a constant: the figures discriminate (0 / 8 / 2 / 1 on /trays / 101 on /all-homewares), and on /all-homewares the same blob reads totalResults 101 while the page's own rendered header text reads 'Showing 1-35 of 101 homewares' - an exact independent match of the blob against the human-visible header. On /mirrors and /storage-baskets the blob was additionally cross-checked against the count of distinct /products/ hrefs in the same SSR grid: storage-baskets 2 tiles vs totalResults 2 (exact), mirrors 7 tiles vs totalResults 8 (one product in the node has no live PDP entry in the grid; the discrepancy is disclosed rather than smoothed, and it does not affect the outcome since the node is excluded on classification grounds anyway). Nothing was estimated and no parent number was reused for a child.

DEDUP: lib/dedup.already_extracted() was run on every candidate leaf the site offers - /bath-towels, /mirrors, /storage-baskets, /trays - and returned None for all four, so nothing was suppressed by the cross-file index. The prior Furniture pass on this SR took 25 furniture rows and recorded no bathroom node either.

CONCLUSION: Loaf is a sofa, bed and homewares brand with no bathroom range whatsoever - no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures, basins, toilets, bathroom taps, bathroom furniture, bathroom storage, bathroom mirrors or bathroom accessories.
